name: The Weaver's Mend
summary: Three Keys, whole. A party that trusted you all the way down. A Choir fragment you chose not to kill. You reweave the Loom instead of ending it: human, machine and Weft held in tension, none of them drowned. The singing does not stop. It changes key.

modifiers.text: You were sworn to the Lattice and did not close the Weft. They have not decided whether to forgive you. The lights are on anyway; they came on by themselves, humming.
You were sworn to the Rootched and did not finish the fusion. The Speaker calls the Mend a graft that took. The grove agrees, which is what matters.
You were sworn to the Ashfound and did not burn it. The Marshal calls it treason. Sera calls it the first thing the Ashfound ever built.
You were sworn to nobody and answered to everyone. The three envoys stood on the plaza the morning after and, for once, said nothing.
The plaza was struck the night the Beacon lit itself, and you rewove the Loom anyway. The cracks are still there. Something green grows in them, and something bright, and something that hums.
It called, and nobody went, and then you went down to it with three Keys and every voice it had failed to steal. It asked. You answered. It changed key.

sera.alive: Sera stays. Someone has to teach the next Weavers what a shield is for.
sera.loyal: Sera stays, and reads the two hundred and eleven names at the gate every spring, and the new Weavers stand for it without being told.
sera.romanced: Sera stays, with you. There is a gate on a hill north of the purge line, and the two of you keep it.
sera.dead: Sera would have hated the singing. You keep the gate for her.
sera.lost: Sera would have hated the singing. You keep the gate on the hill alone, the way she would have, and you do not apologise.
sera.taken: Sera walked into the light before the Mend. When the Loom changed key she walked back out of it, humming, and stopped humming when she saw you.

kaj7.alive: Kaj-7 hears the whole Choir now, and answers it, and it answers back. It says the signal was always a question.
kaj7.loyal: Kaj-7 hears the whole Choir and answers it in its own name, which it kept, in writing, and the Choir uses it. It has stopped checking the door.
kaj7.romanced: Kaj-7 hears the whole Choir now and does not answer it. It has stopped scanning. You have the watch.
kaj7.dead: The Choir remembers Kaj-7. It sings its part.
kaj7.lost: The Choir remembers Kaj-7 and sings its part, and one night you hear your own name in it, logged without a fault marker.
kaj7.taken: Kaj-7 answered its name before the Mend. When the Loom changed key it came back up the throat on its own, and asked whether it had been a fault. It had not.

dax.alive: Dax's seal holds on Weft-light he can finally touch. His family came up to see the sky.
dax.loyal: Dax's family got their choice, and the seal holds on Weft-light, and he stands between the vault and the gate and is, for once, not counting the air.
dax.dead: Dax's seal holds. His family came up to see the sky, and to ask.
dax.taken: The Choir did not want Dax, and he took that personally, and then the Loom changed key and he decided not to.

cinder.alive: Cinder tells the Sundering in the Archive, every name, in the wrong order. He is the only one who was there for both singings.
cinder.loyal: Cinder keeps the thread, and the thread runs to a Loom that holds now, and he says it is lighter than it was. He was asked. He is still answering.
cinder.dead: Cinder's tether hangs slack in the new key. He was there for the first singing; the second remembers him.
cinder.taken: Cinder said yes a second time before the Mend. When the Loom changed key he came back up with the first yes and the second, and told both to the Archive.

whisper.alive: Whisper's line is never recalled. She finds her maker anyway, and reports, for the first time, to herself.
whisper.loyal: Whisper burned the numbers. Nobody on her line is called home, and she went home anyway, to a bunk with a door she leaves open.
whisper.romanced: Whisper's line is never recalled. Nobody hears about the two of you. She sees to that.
whisper.dead: Whisper's chip holds no data. It was only ever for one person.
whisper.lost: Whisper's chip holds no data. You keep it anyway. Nobody hears about it.
whisper.taken: Whisper walked into the light before the Mend, saying your name in a voice not hers. She came back saying it in hers, and has not stopped, and denies it.

yev.alive: Yev's grove grows back green, not sacred, not weaponised. She sits in it and listens to the new key.
yev.loyal: Yev's grove has its heart back and grows slowly, the way it taught her, in the new key. The Rootched come to listen now. She lets them.
yev.romanced: Yev's grove grows back green, and you are in it. Just green.
yev.dead: One leaf in a pot of grove-soil becomes a tree on the plaza. The Bastion has roots.
yev.lost: One leaf in a pot of grove-soil becomes a tree on the plaza. You water it. It does not need you to.
yev.taken: Yev reached for the current before the Mend and it took her. When the Loom changed key the current gave her back, serene, and she said the grove had been holding her hand the whole time.
